open_items: R adds the complete negative, sandbox, forgery and authority-loss matrix; this W stage has its own Apply gate.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Proposal-Fortsetzung MUSS dieselben echten menschlichen Freigabevoraussetzungen wie der nicht aufgeteilte Ablauf verlangen.
oracle.scope: 18.o: direct and split checks bind the complete native inputs, Proposal content, specification basis and recorded engine. Native Work export/restore and result recomputation never supply human approval. The optional Apply handoff retains current actual human provenance and native writer/host gates, including after sandbox changes. Prepared code/tests require their own Apply gate; no Dev execution is claimed.

preconditions: Small complete owned native projects; explicit synthetic human actors and host services retain original native review writes. Every test owns mutable project and Work data.
steps: Compare direct native checks with split and portable Work through public requests and actual checkpoint stores.
Apply the same bound checked content only with current real test-host review originals and authority; observe exact target bytes and unchanged inputs on refusal.
R covers stale/revised bindings, changed engine, checkpoint/audit forgery, failed full validation, path limits, cancellation, loss of human authority under writer lock and historical replay.
